# Navigating Seasons Counselling Services

> BACP-accredited online and telephone counselling across the UK, led by Frances Palmer-Thompson (FdA, MBACP Accred). Specialising in four areas: complex trauma/C-PTSD, sight loss, chronic health conditions, and neurodiversity-affirming therapy. Also works with life transitions and other common reasons for seeking counselling, and offers clinical supervision to qualified counsellors and counselling trainees. Sessions are for adults and young people aged 16+, delivered online or by telephone, not in person.

## Pages

- [Home](https://navigatingseasons.co.uk/): Overview of the counselling practice, specialist areas, credentials, and the separate clinical supervision offering.
- [About Me](https://navigatingseasons.co.uk/about.html): Frances Palmer-Thompson's background, lived experience of sight loss, and credentials.
- [How I Can Help](https://navigatingseasons.co.uk/how-i-can-help.html): Four specialist areas (complex trauma/C-PTSD, sight loss, chronic health conditions, neurodiversity-affirming therapy), plus other reasons people seek counselling such as life transitions, anxiety, depression, grief, stress and workplace burnout.
- [How I Work](https://navigatingseasons.co.uk/how-i-work.html): An integrative approach blending Person-Centred, Psychodynamic, CBT, Transactional Analysis, Gestalt, and IFS-informed parts work.
- [Services & Fees](https://navigatingseasons.co.uk/services-and-fees.html): Free 25-minute discovery call, initial assessment, session fees, cancellation policy, and clinical supervision fees.
- [Qualifications](https://navigatingseasons.co.uk/qualifications.html): BACP accreditation, completed qualifications, specialist training, and training currently in progress.
- [Crisis Support](https://navigatingseasons.co.uk/crisis-support.html): UK crisis helplines for anyone needing immediate support. Navigating Seasons is not itself an emergency or crisis service.
- [Privacy Policy](https://navigatingseasons.co.uk/privacy-policy.html): How personal information is collected, used, and protected, in line with UK GDPR.
- [Contact](https://navigatingseasons.co.uk/contact.html): Contact form, phone, SMS, email, LinkedIn, and frequently asked questions.

## Notes

- Not an emergency or crisis service. Anyone in immediate danger or crisis should be directed to the Crisis Support page, or to call 999 or Samaritans (116 123, free, 24/7).
- Based in Oldbury, West Midlands, serving clients UK-wide online and by telephone only (no in-person sessions).
